subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 01, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 01, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

As we continue to move forward with our mission to create a user-friendly, community-driven Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, we want to take a moment to reflect on the recent development activity and highlight some exciting updates.

Firstly, we've been keeping up with the latest security updates from AlmaLinux, ensuring that our users have the most secure experience possible. This includes updates for .NET, as well as other essential packages. We're committed to providing a safe and stable environment for our users, and we're grateful for the hard work of the AlmaLinux team.

In other news, the Hacktron blog has published an article on how a group could have potentially backdoored Bash, highlighting the importance of security in our codebase. We take these kinds of threats seriously and are always working to improve our security measures.

Robert Haas, a PostgreSQL developer, has written about the struggles the project has encountered due to AI-related issues. While this may not directly affect our project, it's an interesting read for those interested in the world of open-source development.

On the development front, we've made some exciting progress on the Carousel feature. We've added a zoomable blow-up viewer and restored fade and zoom animations, making the experience even more enjoyable for our users. We've also made some minor updates to AcreetionOS_Carousel_Wallpapers, including adding a Carousel_screenshot.

We're also working on updating AcreetionOS-Xlibre, which will bring even more features and improvements to our users. Additionally, we've made some changes to our CI/CD pipeline to ensure smoother releases.

We're grateful for the contributions of our community members, and we're always looking for ways to improve our project. If you're interested in getting involved, please don't hesitate to reach out.

As always, we're committed to transparency and keeping our community informed about our progress. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our email.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community, and we look forward to sharing more updates with you in the future.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift
Co-Lead Developers, AcreetionOS
